title: (RHEA-2013:0921) spice-activex-win enhancement update
portal_summary: An updated spice-activex-win package is now available.
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously-released errata relevant
to your system have been applied.

To install or upgrade to Red Hat Enterprise Virtualization 3.1 refer to the
Installation Guide:

http://access.redhat.com/knowledge/docs/en-US/Red_Hat_Enterprise_Virtualization/3.1/html/Installation_Guide/index.html
portal_description:
The spice-activex-win package provides an ActiveX plug-in for Internet Explorer
that enables users of Red Hat Enterprise Virtualization Manager to connect to
virtual machines using Spice. 

The updated ActiveX plug-in is released as part of the rhevm-spice-client
package.

This updated package provides the following enhancements and fixes the following
bugs: 

* The spice client now supports CAC Smartcard integration; the spice-active-x
component now passes such requests to the client. (BZ#567139)

* Previously, when using the new Native USB Policy mode, connected USB devices
were always shared regardless of whether the Enable USB Auto-Share option was
selected. This issue has been resolved, and USB devices are correctly shared
according to their setting in the Enable USB Auto-Share field. (BZ#856605)

* Previously, when using a Windows client, the "pass control alt delete" check
box in the user portal was not correctly configured. This meant that regardless
of whether or not it was ticked, pressing "ctrl+alt+del" would not correctly
send the event to the guest. Now, the call is handled correctly and the check
box will always send "ctrl+alt+del" to the guest when ticked. (BZ#752093)

* HTTP proxy support is now available for SPICE clients. The "Proxy" property
has been added to the SPICE ActiveX plugin, to configure the client setting via
the controller. (BZ#909496)

All administrators of Red Hat Enterprise Virtualization environments are advised
to install these updated packages.
